cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Ferrari Signature card offering automotive-themed privileges, lifestyle benefits, and milestone vouchers for motorsport enthusiasts.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: Can be availed 2 times in a month and price of second ticket should be less then ₹250.

benefitRows.name: Ferrari Home
benefitRows.offer: Take a trip to the Ferrari Home in Maranello.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Top spender on the card gets a trip to Ferrari home in Italy. Other details not specified.
